name: arith_prime_mul_prime_deficient
statement: (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (h : p * q ≠ 6) : (p * q).Deficient
closed: ∀ (p q : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) (hq : q.Prime) (h : p * q ≠ 6), (p * q).Deficient
informal: A product of two primes other than 6 is deficient — Uses Mathlib2.ab_prime_mul_prime_not_abundant at step 1 (not abundant); step 2: not perfect since (p+1)(q+1) = 2pq forces (p-1)(q-1) = 2, i.e. {p,q} = {2,3}, and p² is a prime power; conclude by Nat.deficient_iff_not_abundant_and_not_perfect.
type: ∀ (p q : ℕ), Nat.Prime p → Nat.Prime q → p * q ≠ 6 → (p * q).Deficient
